title: Go Logic Schema
description: Schema for the go logic type in Corezoid processes

type.description: Specifies this is an unconditional routing logic block

to_node_id.description: ID of the next node in the flow

chunkify.description: Server-emitted execution flag. Not authored by hand — Corezoid adds it to deployed nodes, so pull-process round-trips carry it back. Declared here so the plugin's own pull -> edit -> lint -> push loop does not fail on its own output.
